content.title: MarTech Solutions
content.text: Take over the complexities of demand generation, streamline email campaigns, capitalize on Martech tools, automate marketing tasks, and keep a tab on the metrics with our MarTech assistance. Understanding MarTech At 26.6%, technology accounts for the highest portion of the marketing budget today. MarTech, a combination of marketing technology, is a way of leveraging technology to optimize marketing efforts and reduce complexities in marketing strategies. As your MarTech consultants, we enable you to leverage technology, select the most suitable MarTech solutions like HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, and many more. We offer complete technology consultation and enable you to successfully implement any marketing campaign, automate marketing tasks, and more. Automate & Speed-up Tasks There are several repetitive and time-consuming tasks in marketing that can be easily automated with the help of MarTech tools and stack. This helps speed up processes and optimize workflows. Enhance Customer Relationship MarTech tools have access to past customer interactions and know their behavior. These tools can help build better relationships with the customers and push them down the sales funnel. Accurate Data & Consistent Analytics Having tools capture customer interactions and communications paves way for accurate data collection that helps pave a clearer bigger picture. MarTech tools collect data in real-time and offer complete analytics. Enhanced Team Communication MarTech tools infuse transparency into processes and make it easier for sales and marketing teams to communicate & collaborate. There is reduced friction or bottlenecks in workflows for improved results. MarTech Strategy & Consultation MarTech could be a new field for CMOs or marketing heads. And even those already utilizing the MarTech stack, creating a well-thought-out plan and implementing it can be a challenge. At Classic Informatics, we facilitate MarTech strategy and evaluation through which we not just draft the complete MarTech strategy but also evaluate different tools and platforms based on your marketing and sales goals. MarTech Platforms & Architecture With thousands of MarTech tools, platforms, and solutions, understanding which technology or marketing tech stack would work best for your business could be challenging. Moreover, building a tech architecture for your MarTech stack requires expertise. Our marketing and technology experts can assist you to find the right platform and create an IT architecture best suited for the same. We also audit your marketing ecosystem and pick out the processes, tasks, or workflows that can be improved or automated. MarTech Management Managing the marketing technology stack or the platform that you have implemented for marketing automation is also crucial. You need MarTech experts or platform experts who know the tools inside out. At Classic Informatics, we have brought together a team of experts who can audit, assess, plan, setup, execute, and scale your MarTech strategy. We also analyze different metrics and assess the analytics to ensure your strategy is aligned with your marketing goals. Sales & Marketing Automation Whether it is email drip campaigns, advertisements, surveys, feedback, personalizations, workflows, or other things, there are different MarTech tools that can automate them. You can automate your email campaigns, advertisements, content marketing, social media marketing, and various other tasks. Our marketing automation consultants can offer complete assistance in setting up, executing, and monitoring your sales and marketing automation. They can optimize the funnels, design workflows, and integrate different MarTech tools to automate your marketing and sales efforts Our Success Stories Best from 1000+ web development & software projects.
